title: Generator-normalized slice tensor isomorphisms and their strict coefficient coherence
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a small Grothendieck site, $R$ a sheaf of commutative rings, and $V\in\mathcal C$. Put $R_V=R|_V$ on $\mathcal C/V$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. Use module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], sheaf tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], and $j_{R!}M=(P_M)^\#$, with the direct-sum presheaf $P_M(W)=\bigoplus_{u:W\to V}M(W,u)$ [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf, def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. For every unital commutative $R$-algebra sheaf $S$ there are canonical natural isomorphisms
$$\kappa_N:\operatorname{Res}_{R\to S}j_{S!}N\xrightarrow{\sim}j_{R!}\operatorname{Res}_{R_V\to S|_V}N,$$
for $S|_V$-modules $N$, and $S$-linear isomorphisms
$$\eta_{M,S}:j_{R!}M\otimes_RS\xrightarrow{\sim}j_{S!}(M\otimes_{R_V}S|_V).$$
The action on the source is multiplication on the second tensor factor. The map $\kappa$ is the identity on each extension-presheaf summand and its action. After $\kappa$, the formula for $\eta$ is
$$[m]_u\otimes s\longmapsto[m\otimes s|_{(W,u)}]_u;$$
its inverse is induced by $[m\otimes s]_u\mapsto[m]_u\otimes s$, using $(S|_V)(W,u)=S(W)$. These formulas refer to actual presheaf generators followed by sheafification units and determine the maps uniquely.
For any unbounded $R_V$-cochain complex $P$ and any strict inverse tower $S_\bullet$ of such algebras [def-weil-inverse-system], applying this formula degreewise gives a chain isomorphism of strict $R$-module towers
$$r_P:(j_{R!}P\otimes_RS_n)_n\xrightarrow{\sim}(j_{R!}(P\otimes_{R_V}S_n|_V))_n,$$
natural in chain maps, with an $S_n$-linear lift at each level. With right-to-left composition its equations are
$$r^{i+1}_{P,n}(j_{R!}(d_P^i)\otimes1)=j_{R!}(d_P^i\otimes1)r^i_{P,n},\qquad j_{R!}(1_P\otimes s_n|_V)r_{P,n+1}=r_{P,n}(1_{j_{R!}P}\otimes s_n).$$
For a unital algebra-tower map $a:S_\bullet\to T_\bullet$, both naturality composites take $[p]_u\otimes s$ to $[p\otimes a_n(s)|_{(W,u)}]_u$. In particular $[p]_u\otimes1$ goes to $[p\otimes1]_u$, intertwining the scalar-unit maps. All these equations hold before localization, with no flatness, boundedness or surjectivity assumptions.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sf-slice-normalized-scalar-comparisons] to obtain normalized scalar-restriction and scalar-linear natural isomorphisms and their uniqueness.

Apply [lem-sf-slice-normalized-tensor-transport] to the base site and again to the slice site; the same universes simplify by idempotence of max. These are the normalized tensorLift and sliceTensorLift.

Supply these four comparison families and their generator formulas to [lem-sf-slice-tensor-tower-assembly]. Obtain the normalized ordinary tower comparison, its uniqueness, coefficient naturality and the equation identifying its level maps with the scalar-linear composite.

Apply the inverse component of the scalar-linear isomorphism to its forward generator formula, then use the hom_inv_id identity to derive linear_inverse. Specialize the ordinary generator formula to coefficient 1 to derive unit_normalized. Fill Coherence with these fields. The existing Coherence.onComplexes applies the resulting ordinary natural isomorphism degreewise, so differentials, all transitions and chain maps commute.
